mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (id, pw, username, mobile, gender, image_url) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{userName}, #{mobile}, #{gender}, #{imageUrl})

choose.when: SELECT AAA.* FROM (SELECT ROWNUM() AS r, id, username, mobile, gender FROM member WHERE id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) AAA WHERE AAA.r BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
SELECT AAA.* FROM (SELECT ROWNUM() AS r, id, username, mobile, gender FROM member WHERE mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search}, '%')) AAA WHERE AAA.r BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM member WHERE id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM member WHERE mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')
